products.title: INMP441 MEMS High Precision Omnidirectional Microphone Module I2S
products.body_html:
INMP441 MEMS High Precision Omnidirectional Microphone Module I2S

The INMP441 is a high-performance, low-power, digital output, omnidirectional MEMS microphone with a bottom port. The complete INMP441 solution consists of a MEMS sensor, signal conditioning, analog to digital converter, anti-aliasing filter, power management, and industry-standard 24-bit I2S interface.

The I2S interface allows the INMP441 to be directly connected to digital processors such as DSPs and microcontrollers without the need for an audio codec for use in the system. The INMP441 has a high signal-to-noise ratio and is an excellent choice for near-field applications. The INMP441 has a flat wideband frequency response that results in a high definition of natural sound.

Interface definition:
  1. SCK: Serial data clock for I2S interface
  2. WS: Serial data word selection for I2S interface
  3. L/R: Left/Right channel selection.
  4. When set to low, the microphone outputs a signal on the left channel of the I2S frame.
  5. When set to high level, the microphone outputs signals on the right channel
  6. SD: Serial data output of the I2S interface.
  7. VCC: Input power, 1.8V to 3.3V.
  8. GND: power ground
 
NMP441 connection with ESP32:
  1. SCK -GPIO14
  2. SD - GPIO32
  3. WS - GPIO15
  4. L/R - GND
  5. GND - GND
  6. VDD - VDD3.3

                                                                                                                                            Features:

    1. Digital I2S interface with high precision 24-bit data
    2. High signal to noise ratio is 61 dBA
    3. High sensitivity - 26 dBFS
    4. Stable frequency response from 60 Hz to 15 kHz
    5. Low power consumption: low current consumption 1.4 mA
    6. High PSR: -75 dBFS

products.title: USB QC2.0/3.0 Decoy Trigger Module – 9V/12V/20V Adjustable Boost Power Supply Board
products.body_html:
This is USB Input QC2.0/3.0 Decoy Module Boost Trigger Motherboard 9V 12V 20V Adjustable Power Supply. It's a module used in electronic setups to manage power supplies, particularly in devices that require specific voltage and power delivery.

Instructions for use (need to use PD protocol power supply):

  1. Hold the S button and insert the module into the power supply, then reset it to 5V output (“>>” means power on).
  2. Press and hold the S button, then insert the module into the power source. At this time, switch whether the key lock is on or not, and save the state after power-on. If the key lock is unlocked. To prevent accidental operation, the lock must be unlocked to adjust the voltage after the power is on.
  3. Once powered on, press and hold the button. Once the button is locked, press the button to unlock it.
  4. After powering on, press and hold the button, then press the button to lock the button.
  5. Quick Start: Connect the board to PD power. At this time, the LED light will indicate the currently set decoy voltage. If not turned on, it will default to 5v. Adjust the output voltage. The board is locked by default and must be unlocked first. This method involves holding down the s button and then pressing the s button. At this point, the unlock is complete and you can release the button. Click the [s button] to increase the voltage, or the [s button] to decrease the voltage.

Note: The actual product may vary in slight variation in color and components with the image shown depending upon quantity availability.
